_status: Regular session hours of WIN and WDO by date range, in Sao Paulo local time. Only the ranges below are known. Earlier history is NOT filled from memory: b3/calendar.py infer_session_table() proposes ranges from the downloaded bars (F1), and a human checks them against the B3 Oficio Circular of each period before they are added here. 2026-11-16: periods before the official ones were added from the downloaded bars (source field says INFERRED).

periods.source: INFERRED 2026-11-16 from the Clear demo bars (WIN$N/WDO$N 5-minute, ClearInvestimentos-DEMO): weekly mode of the first bar's open and the last bar's close, Sao Paulo time (b3/calendar.py infer_session_table logic, by ISO week). Bar timestamps only, no prices. The hours follow the US daylight-saving switch in 2022 and 2023 (Monday after the US change). To be checked against the B3 Oficio Circular of each period; HISTORY only.

Press (BP Money, Suno) reports the same 09:00-18:25 window from 03/11/2026, after the end of US daylight saving time.

SECONDARY SOURCE ONLY: press reports (BP Money, Suno, 2026-11) say DOL and WDO trade until 18h30 and that dollar futures hours did not change. OC 005/2026-PRE refers to the B3 'Horario de negociacao' page for dollar futures. Confirm against the B3 page or the broker's symbol sessions (F1.1) before relying on it.
